name: image-lab
description: Brand-aware image studio: every brief becomes a contact sheet of variants scored by a vision critic and regenerated until they pass, UI asset kits matched to your CSS colours with transparent backgrounds and a typed index.ts, and data figures whose labels are read back and checked.
author: zorai

local_model.label: Local model
local_model.description: Hugging Face diffusers model used by the local engine (installed from the Setup tab)

device.label: Local engine device
device.description: auto uses the GPU when it can; or set cuda or cpu

run.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py check
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py load
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py save
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py parse
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py dump
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py example
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py theme
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py estimate
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py sheet
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py load-sheet
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py fix
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py uikit
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py figure
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py setup
python3 scripts/image_lab.py projects
python3 scripts/image_lab.py sheets
python3 scripts/image_lab.py location
python3 scripts/image_lab.py rename
python3 scripts/image_lab.py status
python3 scripts/image_lab.py cancel
python3 scripts/image_lab.py jobs

check.description: Show whether the cloud image provider, the vision critic and the local engine are ready

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py check --format markdown

save.description: Save a project document. Add --project <name> --kind brief|uikit|figure --text "<yaml>"

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py save

estimate.description: Show how many images and critic calls a brief can use. Add --project <name>

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py estimate

sheet.description: Make a contact sheet: every variant is scored by the critic and regenerated with its feedback until it passes. Add --project <name> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py sheet

fix.description: Fix one region of a variant. Add --project <name> --variant <n> --box x0,y0,x1,y1 --prompt "<change>" --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py fix

uikit.description: Generate a UI asset kit in the project's colours with transparent backgrounds, sized WebP/PNG files and index.ts. Add --project <name> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py uikit

figure.description: Draw a chart from CSV/TSV data and read its labels back to check them. Add --project <name> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py figure

theme.description: List the colours defined as CSS variables in a stylesheet. Add --path <file.css>

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/image_lab.py theme

commands.title: Art-direct an image
commands.prompt: Use the image-lab plugin to art-direct {{subject}}: write a brief with a rubric, save it as an Image Lab project, make a contact sheet and tell me which variant passed the critic and why.

inputs.label: What should the image show?
inputs.placeholder: a hero image for the release page

commands.title: Make UI assets from my theme
commands.prompt: Use the image-lab plugin to make a UI asset kit from the colours in {{theme}}: pick the assets this app needs (empty states, icons), save the kit and generate it.

inputs.label: Stylesheet with your CSS colour variables
